author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**


GO:0006888 | endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport | IBA with PTN000274300 , S000000458


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

Tca17
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC15A10.12c


* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Propagation. 
pombe Tca17 is ortholog of S. cerevisiae TCA17 
https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000000774
and is TRAPII (not TRAPI or TRAPIII)

It acts post ER-Golgi transport (this  pathway uses TRAPPI)

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
